_what: Trastuzumab baseline + HER2 epitope. Every score in this challenge is relative to trastuzumab, and the <70% CDRH3 identity gate is computed against cdr_h3 below.
_verify_first: The provided dataset (524k CDRH3 variants) contains the parent trastuzumab row. That row is AUTHORITATIVE for this challenge — confirm every field here against it before trusting these values, and fix this file if they disagree. Numbering scheme matters: cdr_h3 below is Kabat. If abguard or the dataset uses IMGT or Chothia, the CDRH3 boundaries shift and the identity calculation changes.

vl.note: NOT verified in this session — deliberately left null rather than written from memory, because a wrong VL silently corrupts length and identity checks. Take it from the provided dataset's parent row, or from DrugBank DB00072.

cdrs_kabat.source: US app 20190194349 (CDR1/2/3 given explicitly with trastuzumab framework); cdr_h3 independently confirmed inside the vh sequence above as ...YYCSR-WGGDGFYAMDY-WGQGT...
cdrs_kabat.note: cdr_h3 is 11 aa. At the <70% identity ceiling, at least 4 of 11 positions must differ for an optimisation-track design to pass abguard. Conservative 1-2 point mutants WILL be rejected.

contact_regions.source: 8PWH only — a domain IV loop not resolved in earlier structures; MD suggests it stays associated with trastuzumab

her2._use: De novo designs must be epitope-conditioned on these residues. A binder that hits HER2 anywhere else cannot compete with trastuzumab, so it can never be S-tier however tightly it binds. Use these as hotspots for RFD4-Proteina conditioning.
her2._caution: Residue numbering is for full-length HER2 including signal peptide (UniProt P04626). Confirm the offset against whatever construct the generation model and abguard expect before using these as hotspot indices — an off-by-22 (signal peptide) error here is easy and silent.
